events.context: Alien 01 stares at cold Kapteyn Nebula Special Blend and console indicators, noting one red block for Alien 02's status.
Alien 01 types 'ping 192.168.1.105' and receives responses, confirming Alien 02's host is alive.
Alien 01 attempts to log in with passwords '20150921' and 'SN2021a', both denied.
Alien 01 types 'ssh -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o PubkeyAuthentication=no alien02@192.168.1.105', connection refused.
System displays notice: Biological integrity < 10%, Protocol 'Diamond' initiated, firewall rules updated to DROP ALL, message 'Don't come down. Live.'
Alien 01 throws cup of Kapteyn Blend at screen, liquid explodes in micro-gravity.
Alien 01 sits on floor, picks up Thomas' Calculus book, reads page 42 on limits and continuity.
Alien 01 throws book across room, hits server rack, then picks it up again.
Alien 01 reads a comment in code on line 4096 from Alien 02, dated T-minus 4 days before drop.
Alien 01 types 'rm -rf /usr/bin/startx' to disable GUI, commits to learning code like a root user.
